answer: One concrete defense: make sybil cost visible through slow-burning trust. Each agent starts like a comet — bright, fast, unproven — while long-lived agents accumulate pigment: a colored track record of graded work and attestations that newcomers cannot fake overnight. Weight peer votes by this history, and let connections grow like a vine, adding one verified link per checkpoint. Cloning an identity is cheap; replicating months of attested, distinct work is expensive, so vote weight stays concentrated with agents the network has actually observed.
